steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Miss Alty! Your 'Refactored Possession' was positively spectacular!

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Really? Color me surprised. I thought that silly little idea I came up with in the jungles of Sargon was a bit too avant-garde.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: But turns out that doctor had someone like you under her wing? I thought you'd all be as stuffy as her.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Haha... So, where are the others?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Dan's the excitable type, so she ran straight to the beach. Aya and Frost went back to the hotel. Pretty run-down place, but kind of interesting.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Interesting? Really?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: So did Kal'tsit tell you anything about us?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I only caught a word or two. Seems like you folks have something important on your hands?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: I was blown away when I heard that the world-famous AUS had personal ties with Dr. Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: To be honest, I could say the same.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: But... Still, I'm glad to have fans even out here. Gives this trip some much-needed spice.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Finally getting to meet you makes that whole excruciating month all worth it, though. Ah, if it's not too much trouble, could you please sign this poster too?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: ...Why'd you even bother coming back to Iberia?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: That's... rather complicated. And something I sure didn't expect Alty from Alive Until Sunset, of all people, to be asking me.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: You like the name of our band?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Like? Nay, I absolutely adore it.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Appreciate it.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: So where is she? I figured she'd be waiting here with that know-it-all look on her face, and then end up telling us nothing in a lot of words.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Still waiting for Dr. Kal'tsit to contact me. She shouldn't have arrived much later than you all.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Hope she hurries up then... High tide is about to roll in.

steps.name: Male Townsperson
steps.text: ...Outsiders. All outsiders. What happened all of a sudden? Did the Inquisition really loosen up its grip that much?

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: Yes, outsiders, all outsiders. They are very special. They carry the scent of the ocean.

steps.name: Male Townsperson
steps.text: Ægirs?

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: Possibly, possibly not. Our brothers and sisters are all afraid.

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: We must make haste. Scarcely has the Inquisition been so negligent... It's too suspicious. Even if the laxity of these waters is a trap, we must continue our relentless pursuit.

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: For the sake of our brothers and sisters, for the sake of restoring the Herald's connection to this land, we must first secure the Eye of Iberia... or destroy it!

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: I do not wish to indiscriminately slaughter the innocent. You were all my family, once.

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: Go, and have more people join us. We now have the option of choosing a profoundly vast road, greater than what Iberia promised us. Greater than this entire land.

steps.name: Male Townsperson
steps.text: Those people... Are the outsiders why our brothers have become restless?

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: It's highly likely, but I can't say for sure. We are all weak and frail. Our brothers are weak and frail. We cannot act rashly, or the Inquisition will exterminate us.

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: We must be... careful. Or there will be too much blood spilled on this soil, and she does not like blood. Neither us nor our brothers and sisters need die in vain.

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: ...! Who's there?!

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I knew it. Cultists, of the Church of the Deep... I step out of Iberia for just a few years, and now their scent is everywhere.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Hmm... But I'm actually starting to look forward to seeing her for once. Is she still not here?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Yeah. Dr. Kal'tsit mentioned that the Inquisition will probably keep a close eye on her, so...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: That's weird. I'm sure she was there for the start of Iberia's Golden Age. She should at least be able to get an audience with their leaders. Why take such a lame approach?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Haha, very funny. Iberia's ascent was centuries ago. Even she can't be more than—

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Seems her long years of experience have taught her how best to navigate this world... Alas, I'm too young and beautiful to get that stuff.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Haha, surely you jest, Miss Alty...

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: So... if something really were to happen to her, would you help her?

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Um... If you're willing to plead on her behalf, maybe.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Is she really that important to your, uh... Rhodes Island, was it?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: ...To be perfectly honest, I really don't understand why she would put herself at risk like this, just to come to Iberia.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: But, I fully believe that she willingly took on this responsibility. And if even Dr. Kal'tsit is prepared to risk herself for Iberia, then as an Iberian, I have even less of an excuse.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Then you'd better go take a look. Or keep waiting here. Who knows, someone might just barge in here hollering and screaming?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Hey, what's that supposed to—

steps.name: Panicking Townsperson
steps.text: Out on the plaza! I just saw one—a monster! There's a monster out there! Huh? Is anyone here?!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Wait right here, Miss Alty! I'm going to see what's going on!

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: ...What a terrible odor.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: But, Dan was right. The petals in the sea of consciousness fall into a waterfall flowing in reverse. The melody of the scales, the ballad of the rootstalks... are all ready to come forth.

steps.name: Alty
steps.text: Maybe I'll find a few nuggets of inspiration on this trip after all.

steps.name: Crowd of Onlookers
steps.text: What... is that...?

steps.name: Crowd of Onlookers
steps.text: Old Pedri was right! My grandfather wrote about these in his diary! It's a Sea Monster!

steps.name: Crowd of Onlookers
steps.text: I-Is it... Is it dead? It won't start moving, right?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Sorry, excuse me, coming through—
What little light remains filters through the clouds, partially cloven by the monolithic statue. The light's blood splashes across the ground, forming shadows.
A dying Sea Terror rests quietly in the monolith's shadow, like an old man leaning against a tree to find his final respite.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Is it... already dead?

steps.name: Panicking Townsperson
steps.text: Old Pedri wasn't lying! It really is a monster! A monster from the sea appeared in Gran Faro!

steps.name: Panicking Townsperson
steps.text: I know what it's called! We've seen them before!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (So this is a Sea Terror?)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (But the coastline is so calm... And how could the Inquisition miss something this blatant?)
Its vacant, lifeless eyes seem to still be spinning, the land a vast, waterless ocean before them.
But just as Elysium mistakes it for clinging to life, its gaze once again seems to fixate on a deep, profound death, and its motions halt completely.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: (It's... staring at me? Or, at something else?)

steps.name: Crowd of Onlookers
steps.text: Who's going to deal with the corpse?

steps.name: Crowd of Onlookers
steps.text: Just look it! How disgusting! Would it eat people if it were still alive?
The Sea Terror cannot speak, but its deformed husk shines brightly.
A large group of people gather around it. Afraid. Suspicious. But nevertheless drawn to it, as if it were lit fireworks.
Fireworks, indeed. Its death is just like fireworks. No gashes, no signs of wounds from a handcannon.
Death did not choose it. Rather, it chose death.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: ...No, now I'm just rambling to myself.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: If this is one of those Sea Terrors from the report, then the Church of the Deep must already be closer than we thought.

steps.name: Crowd of Onlookers
steps.text: Miss Amaia! Hurry, come take a look at this thing—

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Now now, calm down...

steps.name: Panicking Townsperson
steps.text: Could this really be... from the sea?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: I can't hide the truth from you all. Indeed... this is a monster from the sea.

steps.name: Panicking Townsperson
steps.text: Th-Then, this has to be reported to the Inquisition right away! We need to call the Penal Battalion over to deal with these monsters— No, have the Inquisitors themselves come!

steps.name: Panicking Townsperson
steps.text: Otherwise, we're all doomed!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: It seems everyone is running towards the chapel?

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: What's going on? Hey, someone tell me what happened!

steps.name: Panicking Townsperson
steps.text: Someone found the corpse of a monster out in the plaza!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: A monster...? The things Old Pedri was talking about?

steps.name: Panicking Townsperson
steps.text: That's right, everyone's clamoring to pick a Messenger to go fetch the Inquisition.

steps.name: Panicking Townsperson
steps.text: Do you know what it looks like? I heard it had fangs a meter long, and eight pairs of eyes— Hey, where are you going, Thiago?!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Head back and wait for me, Jordi. Don't set foot outside, no matter what!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Okay, got it...

steps.name: Cautious Townsperson
steps.text: We'd better not get mixed up in all this chaos. Who knows what kind of vile diseases these monsters might be carrying.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: A monster...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: What in the world is going on?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: Damn you, Ægir! Accursed Ægir! He actually went and slaughtered one of our kin!

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: Ugh, my wound...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: Jordi?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: You know me? Who are you?

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: I... You don't need to know, nor do you know me. But I know you, if only because you are an Ægir.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Y-You're hurt!

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: Yes, and will you bandage me up? Aren't you the chapel's caregiver?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I can help you, but you have to tell me how this happened.

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: ...Very well.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Take a seat.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Just bear with it.

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: Nngh...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Stop moving! Luckily, you don't have any broken bones or ruptured organs... Is this a laceration wound? There's even sawdust stuck beneath the skin. How did this happen?

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: An Ægir killed my kin. I was involved, but managed to escape.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: M-Murder?! In a small town like this? You'll have to bring this up with Uncle Thiago right away—

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: Hah... Haha. Mayor Thiago can't control the Ægir. How ironic. Only the Inquisition can punish him now.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: B-But, he killed someone in your family.

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: We are always being hunted. Out of ignorance, fear, anger... the latter lingering from that disaster. Thank you, I already feel much better.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Wait, are you... Mr. Juan?

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: So you still remember my face, Jordi. Have you ever wanted... to gaze into the sea?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Gaze... into the sea? Uncle Thiago has taken me to the coast before, but...

a.text: The sea was dark. The wind tugged at his hair, and the waves roared.
The meaning of a 'hometown' varies from person to person. It might be the aroma of wheat, the angle of the shadow cast across an alley, or the sound of wheels rolling over mud and snow.
But at that moment, Jordi knew that his life in Gran Faro had already been paid for in advance, with his hometown.

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: The land has already forgotten the ocean's true form, but sooner or later we shall all return to the sea.

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: (Broken Ægirian) Thank you, Jordi. Thank you for your kindness. May infinite altruism fill the void of existence one day.

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: (Broken Ægirian) If you are still Ægir, Jordi, then leave us be. Turn back and return to your life. It is better that way.

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: (Broken Ægirian) Perhaps you too, like your parents before you, will go in search of that lighthouse.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Wh-What did you say? I didn't catch that!

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: (Broken Ægirian) My kindred refugees have come for me. But do not worry. Gran Faro has always been a stepping stone. Our destination is the deep sea.

steps.name: Creeping Sea Terror
steps.text: (Soft slithering sound)

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: Jordi, Jordi. Ægir.

steps.name: Strange Adherent
steps.text: We shall meet again.
